text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, cyclophosphamide 2 g/100 mL is not on FDA's drug shortage list. Corvale East holds 54 vials (20.4 days at 2.7 vials/day). Corvale General holds 62 vials (21.6 days at 2.9 vials/day). The product label for NDC 65219013320 lists Jiangsu Hengrui Pharmaceuticals Co., Ltd. (Jinqiao Road Site) as a registered plant for analysis, API manufacture, manufacture, and pack.

Why (FDA record): FDA inspection 1319132 at the Jiangsu Hengrui Jinqiao Road Site ended 2026-04-15 with a VAI classification and was known to FDA on 2026-07-14. FDA's shortage list does not include cyclophosphamide as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Current inventory covers approximately three weeks at both campuses. The VAI inspection at the Jiangsu Hengrui site is documented in FDA records; its effect on supply continuity is not confirmed. Alternate manufacturers ranked 1 through 5 are not on FDA's shortage list today.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to check current allocation and lead time from Avenacy, LLC (plant: EPIC PHARMA LLC) and confirm whether the VAI inspection at the Jiangsu Hengrui site affects supply continuity. Approval: Pharmacy Director.
2. Buyer to evaluate allocation and lead time from Avyxa Pharma, LLC (plant: Dr. Reddy's Laboratories Limited, VAI 2024-05-17). Approval: Pharmacy Director.
3. Buyer to evaluate allocation and lead time from Baxter Healthcare Company (plant: Baxter Healthcare Corporation Deerfield). Approval: Pharmacy Director.
4. Buyer to evaluate allocation and lead time from Epic Pharma, LLC (plant: EPIC PHARMA LLC). Approval: Pharmacy Director.
5. Buyer to evaluate allocation and lead time from Sagent Pharmaceuticals (plant: SAGENT PHARMS INC). Approval: Pharmacy Director.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or formulary substitutions at this time; those decisions remain with treating clinicians and the committee.
